name: feimacode/open-design-agent-kit
summary: 据 Open Design Agent Kit 的维护者介绍，可在编程智能体的对话中借助设计系统、模板和可改编的示例制作路演幻灯片、落地页、仪表板和移动端原型。

The Open Design Agent Kit maintainers describe how to create pitch decks, landing pages, dashboards, and mobile prototypes from a coding agent’s chat using design systems, templates, and remixable examples.
